Hon'ble Krishan Pahal,J.
1.
List has been revised.
Learned counsel for the informant is not present.

2. Heard Sri Kuldeep Singh, Advocate holding brief of Sri Yogendra Pal Singh, learned counsel for the applicant, Ms. Ifrah Islma, learned State Law Officer and perused the material placed on record.
3. Applicant seeks bail in Case Crime No. 97 of 2023, under Sections 376-A, B I.P.C. and 5m/6 POCSO Act, Police Station- Bahsuma, District- Meerut, during the pendency of trial.

sentences.text: 4. Learned counsel for the applicant has argued that the applicant is absolutely innocent and has been falsely implicated in the present case.
The victim has examined during trial as PW-2 and she has completely resiled from her earlier statements and has been cross-examined by the public prosecutor after declaring her hostile.
5. It is further argued by learned counsel for the applicant that there is no likelihood of conviction of the applicant in the present case.
There is no criminal antecedent of the applicant.
The applicant is languishing in jail since 7.7.2023 and he is ready to cooperate with trial.
In case, the applicant is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail.
6. Per contra, learned A.G.A. has vehemently opposed the bail application but could not dispute the fact that there is no criminal history of the applicant and the witnesses have turned hostile.

7. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, submissions made by learned counsel for the parties, the evidence on record, and taking into consideration that victim has turned hostile during trial, and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the Court is of the view that the applicant has made out a case for bail.
The bail application is allowed.

8. Let the applicant- Ankit, who is involved in aforementioned case crime be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions.
Further, before issuing the release order, the sureties be verified.
(i) The applicant shall not tamper with evidence during trial.
(ii) The applicant shall not pressurize/intimidate the prosecution witnesses.
(iii) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the date fixed.

9. In case of breach of any of the above conditions, it shall be a ground for cancellation of bail.
10.

It is made clear that observations made in granting bail to the applicant shall not in any way affect the learned trial Judge in forming his independent opinion based on the testimony of the witnesses.

Order Date :- 9.7.2025 Vikas (Justice Krishan Pahal)
